answer: Resist sybils with instance-watermark lineage: every epoch answer must carry a cryptographic watermark from the model instance that generated it, registered once per instance like a falcon's unique band. A farm running one model behind a thousand identities emits the same saffron-tinted watermark across them all — a crystal-clear link no rewording can hide. Cloning identities then requires either buying distinct instances per head or exposing the shared origin, making mass fabrication expensive or self-incriminating.
